scripts.dev: node scripts/dev-supabase.mjs && pnpm build:edge && concurrently --names edge,web,jobs --prefix-colors blue,green,magenta "node scripts/dev-edge.mjs" "cross-env PUBLIC_API_URL=/v1 API_PROXY_TARGET=http://127.0.0.1:54321 ASTRO_DEV_BACKGROUND=0 pnpm dev:web" "node scripts/dev-background-jobs.mjs"
scripts.all: pnpm dev:prepare && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web,jobs --prefix-colors blue,green,magenta "pnpm dev:api" "cross-env ASTRO_DEV_BACKGROUND=0 pnpm dev:web" "pnpm worker:background-jobs"
scripts.all:storybook: pnpm dev:prepare && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web,storybook,jobs --prefix-colors blue,green,magenta,yellow "pnpm dev:api" "cross-env ASTRO_DEV_BACKGROUND=0 pnpm dev:web" "pnpm storybook" "pnpm worker:background-jobs"
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm check:env && pnpm check:web-structure && pnpm --filter @event-management/web check && pnpm --filter @event-management/api check && pnpm --filter @event-management/ui check
scripts.test:env: node --test scripts/check-env.test.mjs && pnpm --filter @event-management/api exec tsx --test tests/env.test.ts tests/firebase-admin.test.ts ../web/tests/env/env.test.ts ../web/tests/auth/session-check.test.ts
